description: Summarizes incidents inside a neighborhood or rough area: counts by crime type compared with the city, counts by month, the noon-to-midnight share, top streets, and a few notable incidents. Takes a place name, such as Harbor View in Milwaukee, or a lat/lon box, and covers up to 450 days in one call.

days.description: Days ending at the newest incident in the city. Defaults to 90. 400 days is about 14 months.

place.description: Neighborhood or rough area, such as Harbor View or Logan Square. Optional when all four box edges are given.

name: get_area_trends
title: Area crime trends
